text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, both the macarons and the chocolates 
are delicious! This salon de thé has such 
a lovely atmosphere too...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we came to France, aren't 
you?♪

We're in Paris. All I did was mutter "That 
looks delicious" at a French sweets 
special on TV— and the next thing I knew, 
her private jet brought us here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next, a stroll through the gardens of that 
famous palace! And after that, let's go 
see the Arc de Triomphe before heading 
home!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Truly gorgeous flowers, perfectly 
suited for the City of Flowers♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, next time let's take one 
together! I'll go find a staff member who 
might take it for us!

"In a garden this vast, it'll be terrible 
if we get separated, so let's stick... 
Before I could stop her, she had already 
dashed off."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Umm, is there a staff member I can 
ask...)

text_block_list.name: French Fan
text_block_list.text:
Vous êtes Satano Diamond ? Je vous ai vu 
courir ! Je suis fan !

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Merci! I'm thrilled! To think I have fans 
in France too! I have to go tell Trainer 
right aw――"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh dear...? Which direction did I 
come from?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (O-Oh no! I have to contact Trainer—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, my battery! Right, it's 'cause I've 
been taking photos non-stop.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Even if we try to meet up... there are 
multiple entrances, so we might pass right 
by each other.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"In a situation like this... let's head to 
the next destination! Place Charles de 
Gaulle by the Arc de Triomphe should be 
wide open and easy to spot them in."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Alright! Once I get off this bus, I'll 
take the subway and――)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Phew, we've arrived~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wait... Is this Longchamp!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(T-To think I came here without even 
realizing it! Umm... I-I should take the 
subway again! Or maybe a taxi... Ah, but 
my remaining cash...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... "It's okay, stay calm"...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(If Trainer were here, I wonder if they 
would have said that.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Just hearing them say that brings me a 
strange sense of relief. ...And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Now I'm even hallucinating sounds...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: !? Trainer! Wh-Why are you here...!
choice_data_list: I figured if it was you, you'd be here.

I figured if it were you, you'd be right 
here.

text_block_list.text:
She's not used to public transit yet. I 
figured that if she got flustered, she'd 
head somewhere she held dear.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer... san...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't do anything on my own. I just 
got overconfident and made things worse...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer... it seems you understood 
that side of me even better than I did 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, just how much you were helping 
me... I realized it all over again today."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. For coming to pick me 
up.
choice_data_list:
No matter how many times it takes, I'll 
come to get you.

text_block_list.text:
She must have spent an anxious time all on 
her own. To avoid building up fatigue, it 
seemed best for her to head back home 
soon.
choice_data_list:
You're tired, aren't you? Let's head back 
to Japan soon—

You're tired, right? Let's head back to 
Japan soon—

text_block_list.text:
The sensation of a gentle tug on the hem 
of my clothes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah! I'm so sorry! Um...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We still have time before the flight, 
and... we're all the way in France, so... 
um...
choice_data_list: …Shall we walk just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! Jeez. You're so mean, Trainer. You 
already know, so why'd you say that?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't forgive you! If you're going 
to be mean, then I'll be selfish too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to take a walk around Paris 
together a little longer. I want to paint 
over the loneliness of getting lost with 
fun memories!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So this treat is your souvenir from your 
trip to France... ...It is sweet! 
Sickeningly sweeeet!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Reunited in Paris, the City of Light! 
Thanks for the romantic travel stories, 
too♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Look forward to the next souvenirs 
from France too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ! Yes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to enjoy every single second we 
have! Enough to completely overwrite how 
lonely I felt when I was lost!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So this treat is your souvenir from your 
trip to France... ...It is sweet! 
Sickeningly sweeeet!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Reunited in Paris, the City of Light! 
Thanks for the romantic travel stories, 
too♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Look forward to the next souvenirs 
from France too!
